summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K reporting share repurchases under the second tranche of its 2026 buy-back programme, announced 6 May 2026, running 19 May–20 July 2026. From 29 June–3 July 2026, Equinor bought 439,635 shares at an average NOK 313.67 per share; total accumulated under the tranche is 2,754,103 shares (0.12% of capital). The programme is an open-market repurchase on OSE, CEUX, and TQEX. Post-transactions, Equinor holds 13,259,988 own shares (0.55% of capital) including savings-plan shares. This is a routine capital return disclosure under EU MAR. Watch for completion of the tranche by the deadline and potential impact on share float.
